question: Visakhapatnam is the _______ landlocked and well-protected port.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Vishakhapatnam Port

 
• ​Vishakhapatnam Port is India's deepest port 
 
• The Deepest port in India it almost deals major exports of iron ore to the rest of the world.
 
• Marine transport in India is controlled and administered by the state and central governments.
 
• While the shipping ministry manages the major ports, the intermediate and the minor ports are administered by the State government in which the port is located.
